question: In the processing and presentation of peptides of extracellular origin intervene (n):
analysis: In the processing and presentation of peptides of extracellular origin, the MHC class II pathway is primarily involved. This pathway includes the involvement of the HLA-DM molecule, which plays a crucial role in the loading of peptides onto MHC class II molecules. The other options listed are more relevant to the MHC class I pathway, which deals with intracellular peptides. Therefore, the correct answer is the HLA-DM molecule.
